extraction.description: The screenshot shows an instructional diagram for the Human in the Loop validation flow in the Benefit Claims Processing exercise. Robot and agent outputs feed into a Case Worker Review step, after which the human decision produces outputs. The diagram lists the inputs sent to the case worker and the expected outputs returned from the human review.
extraction.step_instructions: Informational screenshot — no user action required. It shows the inputs to provide to the Case Worker Review human validation step and the outputs expected from the review: Action and DenialReason.
